details.cache: Fresh browser context; HTTP cache explicitly disabled with CDP; service workers blocked.
details.observation: Cold-opening snapshot taken 2500 ms after the requested hero artwork decoded; the actual observation end is recorded above. Deferred background camera preparation can be included in this window.
details.byteMethod: Chrome DevTools Network.loadingFinished.encodedDataLength, actual received encoded image bytes. Null denotes an unfinished or failed request. This is distinct from decoded image-memory size or response-body byte accounting.
details.budgetPolicy: Measured values are reported without an invented byte, timing or CLS pass threshold.

environment: Fresh local Chromium contexts; service workers blocked; production headers expected. These are functional/visual checks, not field-performance measurements.
method: Native document scrolling, computed geometry/opacity, persistent DOM references, real links and keyboard interaction. Captures wait for visible artwork to decode. Scene artwork quality still requires human visual inspection.
